columns.name: sample_id
columns.note: Integer string matching sample_id in data/test.csv; must cover all 22 test rows with no duplicates

columns.name: uniformity_y
columns.note: JSON array of floats serialised as a string (e.g. "[0.1, 0.2, ...]"); must have >= 10 elements; do NOT rescale or reshape — a poorly shaped curve is a legitimate low score

structural_checks: prediction.csv must be non-empty (at least one data row)
columns 'sample_id' and 'uniformity_y' must both be present (exact names, no aliases tolerated)
each uniformity_y value must be a JSON-parseable array of floats
each uniformity_y array must have length >= 10
submission must contain one row for every sample_id in data/test.csv (22 rows total, no missing)
